description: Normative native module dependency graph. Production modules may depend only on listed production modules. Spike modules may depend on production modules and listed spike peers. Planned modules are reserved edges for later phases.

roles.production: Stable domain or platform-neutral library used by product code.
roles.spike: Feasibility adapter or composition retained until a later promote/retire decision.
roles.planned: Reserved module name with allowed edges; no target yet.

runtime.notes: Owns CompiledScene/RenderJob value types, frame samples, and hot-path telemetry formulas (p99/CPU/memory; GPU host-observed timing distinct from device counters); no Scene IR or GPU backends.

export-core.notes: Owns OutputTransaction and the VideoSink/FrameBridge ports, plus Rec.709 RGBA8 flatten/handoff into EncodableFrame; no Apple encoder types.

render-metal.notes: Production Metal backend over render-core Renderer; metal-cpp/ObjC++ stay private. Offline metallibs cover smoke helpers and SDF primitive draws. Metal glyph atlas pages retain GPU textures across in-flight frames via the resource registry. Clip/mask scripts map nested scissors to MTLScissorRect and shape masks to stencil increment/decrement.

export-apple.notes: AVFoundation VideoWriter plus AppleVideoSink (VideoSink adapter). Domain callers use export-core ports; AVFoundation types stay private to the adapter.

transfer-apple.notes: Isolated Metal/IOSurface bridge; must not become a production default path.

direction.notes: Style Bible, Style Package registry, intents, DirectedFilm, track precedence, Motion Grammar. Depends only on diagnostics and core-model; never on render-metal or export-apple.

compiler.notes: Authoring → CDS lowering (direction) → Scene IR. Must not depend on export-apple or render-metal.

scene-ir.notes: yyjson is a private implementation dependency and must not leak into public headers.

geometry.notes: Path flatten/tessellate/stroke and compile-once mesh cache. libtess2 is a private fill dependency and must not leak into public headers; stroking is local.

asset-pipeline.notes: Bounded PNG/WebP decode, safe SVG subset import to Path2f, content-hash disk/GPU asset cache, and CPU texture atlas with padded packing plus upload batching. stb_image, libwebp and nanosvg are private; Security.framework is private for SHA-256. Public headers expose no decoder/GPU types; atlas upload plans are CPU staging bytes only.

typography.notes: CPU text shaping with HarfBuzz, FreeType glyph raster and ICU grapheme/bidi adapters, plus a CPU glyph atlas over TextureAtlas with in-flight eviction. External deps resolved via pkg-config (see third_party/typography-deps/PIN.json). Font faces come from explicit pinned paths (third_party/fonts); no implicit system font catalog. HarfBuzz/FreeType/ICU headers stay private.

render-core.notes: GPU-neutral DrawOp/PassDesc, Renderer, render-graph, registry, pools, shader features, pipeline cache, instance batching, 2D primitive raster/lowering, nested scissor/shape-mask clip compositor, screen-space hard/soft shadow passes with quality-tier separable blur plus a Paper depth-shadow capability probe, linear-light premultiplied compositor with Rec.709/sRGB-transfer encode, and viewport visibility/culling with opaque-then-transparent draw sorting plus counters; no Apple/Metal headers; no FrameLease.

preview.notes: Random-access frame preview: FrameState → Rec.709/sRGB RGBA8 via linear compositor proxies, PNG encode with sRGB chunk; Compression.framework private. No Metal/AVFoundation.

export.notes: Scene IR video export orchestration: RenderJob phases, preview Rec.709 raster, VideoSink/FrameBridge, OutputTransaction. Platform encoders stay behind VideoSink factories (e.g. AppleVideoSink).

forbidden_examples.reason: Domain values must stay free of Metal backends.
Domain values must stay free of AVFoundation adapters.
Creative direction must not reach the GPU backend.
Scene compilation must not depend on the platform encoder.
